description: Animated 3HP blank panel carrying two drifting acid smileys
notes: place it beside another Animatek blank, with nothing between them, and the two panels become one canvas: the seam between them disappears and the marks drift across both.
there is nothing to patch and nothing to turn; the speed and the colour of the marks are set from the module's menu and apply to the whole run of adjoining blanks.
menu: Pause animation — stops the animation on every Animatek blank in the rack, not only this one; it is not saved with the patch
Speed — how fast the marks drift, from a quarter speed to eight times, applied to every blank in the run
Mark colour: Auto (pick a free one), Blue, Orange, Green, Purple, Cyan, Rose — a named colour paints the whole run, and Auto lets the panels share out the palette between them
